description: Free. Wait for a job from a paid tool: returns as soon as it finishes (or, with until "changed", as soon as its status changes), else after wait_seconds (default 45, at most 50). Call it again while finished is false. A finished job comes with its result and studio_url; show the user the first line (tokens and credits) and the studio_url. Sends progress notifications while it waits when the client asks for them.
name: wait_for_job
title: Wait for job
